title: Escape from Hastinapur
logline: Spears in the Lamp Bazaar. Carry the grain plea out before dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: A spear! Roll clear, {name}. Then hit back.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Grey cords on their wrists. Not the city watch.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: A shield. Shove it, then strike.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: They circle you. Keep moving. Keep striking.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: The bridge is shut. Hand over the plea.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: My shield is split. Still I stand.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Up! Keep moving. The plea is safe.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Anything in hand helps. It will not last.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: Again, {name}. The plea can wait a breath.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dandaka
dialogue.text: Open the gate. Those fields feed my kin too.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: That was a dance. Lamp-Runner, indeed.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjara
dialogue.text: Ulka sends word: another courier falls tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Suvrata
dialogue.text: The far torch just went out. Keep walking, {name}.
